$comment: Generated by scripts/schemas from trialfolio.contracts.attempt.AuthenticationRecord, in serialization mode. Validation and serialization modes give the same schema. Never edit it by hand.
description:
The authentication record, `authenticating.json`, written durably before an experiment's
attempt makes Trial Folio's own authentication call, so the budget counts the call even when
the process is killed before its exchange is recorded (experiment attempts). An attempt
that sends with a token its session already holds has none.

plan_hash.description: The plan the attempt runs under.
plan_hash.title: Plan Hash

session.description: The number of the session that started the attempt.
session.title: Session

sequence.description: The attempt's place in its session: 1 for the first attempt it starts.
sequence.title: Sequence

repeat_of.description:
The attempt that `--repeat`'s confirmation named, for an attempt it started; null for any
other.
repeat_of.title: Repeat Of

title: AuthenticationRecord
